description: Get a Stripe Checkout link to top up the credits on the API key you are calling with. Starter pack: $5 for 500 credits. Pro pack: $20 for 2500 credits. 1 credit = $0.01. Give the returned checkout_url to a human to complete payment in a browser; the credits are added to this key automatically once the payment succeeds, usually within seconds. Calling this tool does not charge anything and costs no credits.

pack.description: Which pack to buy. Defaults to "starter" ($5 / 500 credits). "pro" is $20 / 2500 credits.

packs.description: How many of that pack. Defaults to 1.

name: buy_credits
